newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Oct unemployment falls to 5.14 pct - IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Oct unemployment falls to 5.14 pct - IBGE.

text.p: Brazil's October unemployment rate fell to 5.14 percent from 5.23 percent in September, the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
The number of people employed increased in most urban areas of Brazil, but especially in the southern city of Porto Alegre, the IBGE said.
The number of people employed in the construction sector rose 2.4 percent and 1.1 percent in the retail sector, whereas the number of employed in the service industry fell 1.1 percent.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
